publisher_scope_notice: Eight Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary English entries were directly opened on 2026-11-01. Direct evidence supports POS and senses only. Oxford topic CEFR tags are not independently verified exact-sense word CEFR labels; C1 is provisional. No independent reviewer, audio listening, physical iPhone testing or production launch claimed.

records.original_english_definition: The feeling of having conflicting attitudes about the same thing.
records.original_burmese_meaning: အကြောင်းအရာတစ်ခုတည်းအပေါ် ဆန့်ကျင်ဘက်ခံစားချက်နှစ်မျိုး တစ်ပြိုင်နက် ရှိနေခြင်း
records.original_example_sentence: She felt ambivalence about accepting the promotion abroad.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford directly confirms a mixture of positive and negative feelings about a person or situation. The frozen promotion example uses the correct about-complement; the English and Myanmar are plausible but require an independent naturalness check. No entry-specific CEFR label was observed.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: ကိစ္စတစ်ခုအပေါ် နှစ်သက်သည့်စိတ်နှင့် မနှစ်သက်သည့်စိတ် နှစ်မျိုးလုံး ရောယှက်နေခြင်း
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: He felt ambivalence about leaving his familiar workplace.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Does the bilingual card communicate simultaneous positive and negative feelings rather than uncertainty or indifference? Find independently reviewable exact-sense C1 evidence.

records.original_english_definition: Something that seems to belong to a different historical period.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ခေတ်ကာလနှင့် မကိုက်ညီဘဲ အခြားခေတ်တစ်ခုမှ ဖြစ်သကဲ့သို့ ထင်ရသော အရာ
records.original_example_sentence: The old payment machine looked like an anachronism in the modern shop.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford sense 1 is a person, custom or idea that appears old-fashioned in the present; sense 2 is a historically misplaced detail in a work. The frozen old payment machine sentence uses sense 1 by extension; do not mistakenly translate as a historical dating error. The History c2 topic tag follows sense 2, not independent CEFR verification for sense 1.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: ယနေ့ခေတ်နှင့် မကိုက်ညီတော့ဘဲ ခေတ်ဟောင်းက အရာတစ်ခုလို ဖြစ်နေသောအရာ
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The outdated ticket machine seemed an anachronism in the new station.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Does the machine example naturally express the old-fashioned sense rather than a historical-placement mistake? Check exact-sense level separately.

records.original_english_definition: A strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.
records.original_burmese_meaning: လူတစ်ဦး သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုအပေါ် ပြင်းထန်စွာ မနှစ်သက်ခြင်း
records.original_example_sentence: His antipathy towards unnecessary rules was well known.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford directly records a formal noun for strong dislike, including antipathy to/towards a person or thing. The frozen example about unnecessary rules is grammatical; distinguish personal aversion from neutral disagreement. No headword CEFR level was observed.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: လူတစ်ဦး သို့မဟုတ် အရာတစ်ခုကို ပြင်းပြင်းထန်ထန် မနှစ်မြို့ခြင်း
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: Her antipathy towards unfair rules was clear to everyone.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Does the Myanmar expression indicate strong dislike, not just disagreement, and is C1 justified for this exact sense?

records.original_english_definition: To hear both sides of a disagreement and make a decision about it.
records.original_burmese_meaning: အငြင်းပွားမှု၏ နှစ်ဖက်စလုံးကို နားထောင်ပြီး ဆုံးဖြတ်ပေးသည်
records.original_example_sentence: An independent expert was asked to arbitrate the dispute.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford describes formally settling a disagreement between parties, including arbitrate in a dispute and arbitrate between A and B. The frozen independent-expert example is grammatical but its definition should emphasize official dispute resolution rather than merely hearing both sides. Discussion and agreement c2 is a topic tag, not independent exact-sense CEFR approval.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: အငြင်းပွားနေသည့် နှစ်ဖက်ကြား ဝင်ရောက်ညှိနှိုင်းဆုံးဖြတ်ပေးသည်
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The independent panel will arbitrate between the two companies.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Should the English and Myanmar emphasize an authorized neutral decision rather than an informal opinion? Confirm exact-sense C1 with independent source.

records.original_english_definition: Hostile and ready to argue or fight.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ရန်လိုပြီး ငြင်းခုံရန် သို့မဟုတ် တိုက်ခိုက်ရန် အသင့်ရှိသော
records.original_example_sentence: The passenger became belligerent when staff refused his request.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford adjective sense 1 means aggressive and unfriendly; sense 2 describes a state fighting a war and is restricted to prenominal position. The frozen passenger sentence clearly uses sense 1, not the wartime meaning. Both c2 tags are topic labels and not independent exact-sense CEFR evidence.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: ရန်လိုပြီး စကားများရန် သို့မဟုတ် ရန်ဖြစ်ရန် အသင့်ဖြစ်နေသော
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The customer became belligerent after the manager refused the demand.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Check whether the Myanmar gloss and passenger example teach interpersonal hostility, not a state at war; establish independent exact-sense C1 evidence.

records.original_english_definition: Kind and willing to help other people.
records.original_example_sentence: A benevolent donor paid for the village library.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford adjective sense 1 denotes kindness and generosity, especially by someone in authority; sense 2 occurs in names of charitable organizations. The frozen donor example fits sense 1; formal/register and c2 Personal qualities topic tag must not be treated as independent CEFR classification.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: သူတစ်ပါးအကျိုးကို လိုလားပြီး ကြင်နာရက်ရောသော
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: A benevolent neighbour quietly paid the family's school fees.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Does the Myanmar convey benevolence rather than ordinary friendliness? Obtain independent exact-sense C1 CEFR evidence.

records.original_english_definition: The quality of expressing something in few words or lasting briefly.
records.original_burmese_meaning: စကားအနည်းငယ်ဖြင့် တိုတောင်းစွာ ဖော်ပြမှု သို့မဟုတ် အချိန်တိုတောင်းမှု
records.original_example_sentence: The chairperson appreciated the brevity of her report.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford directly distinguishes concise expression (sense 1) from short duration (sense 2). The frozen example about a report demonstrates sense 1 only, but the frozen definition and Myanmar gloss merge both senses. Recommend a single concise-expression gloss and keep short duration for a separate reviewed sense, not a second quota item without policy.
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The editor praised the brevity of the final report.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Split the two dictionary senses before signoff; check Myanmar naturalness and source-backed exact-sense C1.

records.original_english_definition: Careful to consider possible risks before acting or speaking.
records.original_burmese_meaning: လုပ်ဆောင်ခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် ပြောဆိုခြင်းမပြုမီ ဖြစ်နိုင်သည့် အန္တရာယ်များကို သတိထားစဉ်းစားသော
records.original_example_sentence: The director was circumspect when discussing the proposed merger.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford directly describes considering risks before acting, marked formal. The frozen merger discussion example is grammatical; Myanmar should emphasize careful risk evaluation rather than hiding information. No exact-sense CEFR level was observed.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: ဖြစ်နိုင်သည့် အန္တရာယ်များကို ကြိုတင်စဉ်းစား၍ သတိကြီးစွာ ဆောင်ရွက်သော
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The negotiator was circumspect when discussing the proposed deal.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Is the Myanmar gloss natural and does it communicate caution before action rather than secrecy? Find independently reviewed exact-sense C1 level.
